parameters.content:
## W26 Lead Enrichment (free, self-hosted)
POST /webhook/lead-enrichment { businessName, website, name?, email?, whatsapp?, country?, message? }

1. Validate + SSRF-safe website normalisation
2. Fetch the public homepage (no paid API)
3. Extract contacts / socials / tech, score quality + opportunity
4. Only contactable leads reach Tech360 (LEAD_INTAKE de-dupes); the rest return `needs_review`

Design adapted from n8n-gtm-lead-enrichment (MIT). Apify, Clay, Zoho and Sheets replaced by free sources. Credential needed: "Tech360 API Secret" (header x-n8n-secret).

meta.description: Free lead enrichment: validate → fetch public website → extract contacts/tech → score → create lead in Tech360 only if contactable. Design adapted from n8n-gtm-lead-enrichment (MIT).
